question: Who assumed charge as the 18th Commander-in-Chief of the Andaman & Nicobar Command (CINCAN) on 1 June 2025?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Lt General Dinesh Singh Rana**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• **Lt General Dinesh Singh Rana** assumed charge as the **18th Commander-in-Chief of the Andaman & Nicobar Command (CINCAN)** on **1 June 2025**.
 
• The **Andaman & Nicobar Command (ANC)** is India’s first and only tri-service theater command, integrating the Army, Navy, and Air Force for joint operational capabilities in the strategically important Andaman and Nicobar Islands region.
 
• Lt General Dinesh Singh Rana succeeded his predecessor in this role, marking a new chapter in the leadership of the ANC, which plays a critical role in ensuring India’s maritime security and strategic interests in the Indian Ocean Region (IOR).
 
• He brings extensive experience and expertise to the position, having served in various capacities across the Indian Armed Forces during his illustrious career.
 
• The appointment of Lt General Dinesh Singh Rana underscores the importance of maintaining a robust defense posture in the Andaman & Nicobar Islands, given their geopolitical significance and proximity to key maritime routes.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

__
 
• **Andaman & Nicobar Command (ANC):**

 
 
• The ANC was established in **2001** as India’s first unified command to integrate the Army, Navy, and Air Force for joint operations in the region.
 
• It is headquartered at **Port Blair**, the capital of the Andaman and Nicobar Islands.
 
• The command is responsible for safeguarding India’s strategic interests in the Indian Ocean Region (IOR), which includes overseeing vital sea lanes and countering maritime threats.
 
 
 
• **Importance of the Andaman & Nicobar Islands:**
 
 
• The islands are located near the **Strait of Malacca**, one of the world’s busiest shipping lanes, making the region strategically significant for global trade and energy security.
 
• The ANC plays a key role in monitoring maritime traffic and ensuring the security of India’s exclusive economic zone (EEZ).
 
• The region is a hub for geopolitical competition, with growing Chinese naval presence in the Indian Ocean, making the ANC’s role critical for India’s defense and foreign policy objectives.
 
 
 
• **Background of Lt General Dinesh Singh Rana:**
 
 
• Lt General Dinesh Singh Rana has had an illustrious career in the Indian Army, holding several key positions across various operational and strategic domains.
 
• His leadership abilities and operational expertise make him a suitable choice for this prestigious role.
 
• His appointment aligns with India’s focus on enhancing jointness and interoperability among the three armed services.
 
 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/4f750a2730aad0987b5e719f277ddc90129c657928205c4d3b5aa23049023fa5.png] **Important Points__**

 
• **Significance of Integrated Commands:**

 
 
• Integrated commands like the ANC enable better coordination and jointness among the Army, Navy, and Air Force, enhancing operational efficiency and combat readiness.
 
• Such commands are essential for addressing modern security challenges, including maritime threats, terrorism, and natural disasters.
 
 
 
• **Strategic Role of ANC:**
 
 
• The ANC serves as a forward operating base for India’s defense forces, enabling rapid response to threats in the Indian Ocean Region.
 
• It also facilitates humanitarian assistance and disaster relief (HADR) operations, given the vulnerability of the region to natural disasters such as cyclones and tsunamis.
 
 
 
• **Future Developments:**
 
 
• India is focusing on enhancing the capabilities of the ANC through infrastructure development, acquisition of modern platforms, and integration of advanced technologies.
 
• Efforts are underway to strengthen maritime domain awareness (MDA) and bolster India’s position as a net security provider in the Indian Ocean Region.
